displayName: CADP-AI-T5-R1 external readout authority foundation source and tests
priorAbsorption: T5-R1 adds a pure internal Guard Contract foundation for a possible future external readout: strict identity/ingress shapes, exact metadata allowlist, redaction rejection, freshness outcomes, deterministic receipts, and literal-false authority fields. Independent review repaired raw JSON serialization into a trap-free canonical frozen snapshot and added real-calendar validation. No adapter, transport, authentication mechanism, credential, provider call, mutation, or invocation authority exists.

findings.summary: Initial receipt serialization invoked caller-controlled toJSON and did not provide canonical frozen snapshot semantics.
findings.nextAction: Retain the four reviewer-added canonicalization and timestamp regression tests; require a fresh governed packet before any adapter or transport work.

nextScanRecommendation: Re-scan only if a separately authorized T5 adapter tranche changes these surfaces or opens authentication/transport composition.
